newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel TV shows border police beating Palestinians.
newsitem.headline: Israel TV shows border police beating Palestinians.

text.p: Israel's police commissioner on Monday ordered the suspension of two paramilitary policemen caught on an amateur video beating Palestinians.

State-owned Channel One television broadcast the video, which it said was recorded last month by an amateur Palestinian cameraman, showing the policemen abusing six Palestinians who entered Jerusalem without Israeli work permits.
In the courtyard of an apartment complex, the two policemen kicked some of the Palestinians in the head, kneed another in the stomach and made others lie on the ground and do push-ups.
The report said the abuse went on for 45 minutes.
Police said in a statement that national police commissioner Assaf Hefetz took a serious view of the incident and ordered the suspension of the two policemen pending the results of an investigation.
Palestinians frequently complain about abuse by border police, who are deployed across the West Bank.
